title: Predator Hulls & Living Space
summary: Brand-new predator ship designs, 13 two-colour liveries, planets in every sector and a dense layered space background.
items: All 8 player hulls rebuilt: curved jaw horns with teeth, hooked wings, near-black armour and sharp high-resolution detail
13 paint schemes with a second accent colour - Night Raider, Inferno, Toxic, Royal, Blood Moon, Ice Phantom and more (Hangar → Paint)
Sun, planets and moons in every sector: Earth, Moon, Mars, a ringed gas giant, ice, lava and violet worlds
Layered parallax background: swirling nebula, milky-way star band with clusters, asteroid belts, ship scrap and derelict satellites
Navigation buoys with beacon lights around every jump gate and the Home Base; 42 bonus boxes per sector
Pilot cargo drop: on death all raw ore drops in a box anyone can steal - refined ore stays safe
Bigger, zoom-independent hull & shield bars above your ship

title: New Fleet, Alien Warships & Full Shop
summary: Piranha and Viper join the fleet, aliens are now warships, and the shop has the complete catalogue with clear prices and hover details.
items: New hulls: Piranha (T1 gunship) and Viper (T2 raider, Overdrive ability)
Alien warships replace the old bugs: Lancer, Warden and Reaper join Drone, Stinger, Ravager and Bastion
More enemies in every sector for more action
Lasers VL-0 to VL-4 Hyperion, shields Aegis-Micro to Aegis-X, engines Ion-1 to Ion-X
SAB-50 shield absorber ammo (key 5) and DCR-250 deceleration rockets
Utility CPUs: Auto-Rocket, Cargo Expander (+50% hold), Ammo Auto-Switcher, Emergency Warp (key Y)
Shop shows PRICE in green or red and explains every item when you hover it
Soft engine glow with light 'snowflake' particles instead of big exhaust plumes

title: Wild Space Opens
summary: Defeat the Hive Overlord to unlock sectors 2-1 to 2-4, face smart ace pilots and use safe zones at every gate.
items: Sectors 2-1 to 2-4 with rich ore, ion storms and new bosses
Smart ace pilots: rockets, drones, emergency repairs and afterburner retreats
Safe zones around every jump gate and the Home Base
Assembly Lab with blueprints dropped by world bosses
Ore overclocking: feed Pyrocrite, Tecrylium or Xeno Crystal for laser and shield boosts
New camera with smooth follow and an edge arrow pointing at your locked target
Weapon and ability cooldowns shown on the action bar

title: Classic Rules
summary: Original lobby music, new logo, compact HUD, co-op reward sharing and classic death rules.
items: Original soundtrack 'Orbital Assault' in the lobby
Hull and shield bars above your ship, compact HUD with adjustable size
Co-op: credits, XP and ore are split between pilots; bosses pay everyone in full
Radiation zone outside the map with a 30 second countdown
Homing smart bomb (B) and click-to-collect loot boxes

title: Cargo, Drones & Living Sectors
summary: Cargo window, combat drones, critical hits, dynamic music and sectors full of NPC pilots.
items: Cargo window [C]: sell and refine ore anywhere
Combat drones with formations
Critical hits with big damage numbers
Traders, pirates, rivals and allied miners roam every sector
Free co-op for 2-4 pilots
